name: appwrite-nl-cursor-plugin
description: Env-based Appwrite MCP for self-hosted (and Cloud): connect once, every project picks up endpoint and keys from .env — plus docs MCP, skills, and rules.

APPWRITE_ENDPOINT.title: Default Appwrite endpoint
APPWRITE_ENDPOINT.description: Global fallback when the workspace .env has no APPWRITE_ENDPOINT / VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT. Example: https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1 or https://your-host/v1. Workspace .env always wins.
